name: Odaiba-Kaihinkoen
tagline: Toranomon in 23 minutes and Tokyo in 24 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 30 minutes to Otemachi, 38 minutes to Shinjuku, 36 minutes to Shibuya and 27 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 5.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 9.7 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 5.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.2 m to 9.5 m, a difference of 9.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is フジテレビ湾岸スタジオビル診療所, about 17 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 癌研有明病院, about 26 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, 1K ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 1LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. 2LDK ¥400,000 to ¥410,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Tokyo-Teleport is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Odaiba-Kaihinkoen is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Odaiba-Kaihinkoen. Tokyo-Teleport has the Rinkai Line, a different set from Odaiba-Kaihinkoen. To Toranomon, for instance, Tokyo-Teleport takes 9 minutes longer. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

neighbours.lead: Aomi is ahead on quiet, but Odaiba-Kaihinkoen is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Odaiba-Kaihinkoen. It is served by the same lines as Odaiba-Kaihinkoen. To Toranomon, for instance, Aomi takes 10 minutes longer. On quiet, Aomi comes out ahead.

noiseSources: The 首都高速湾岸線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
台場青海線 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Yurikamome serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
